objective: Auditar ESTELAR septiembre 2026 para identificar exactamente los dias que el endpoint /inteligencia/iscam/freshness marca como detalle faltante o no conciliado. Comparar Runtime V2 vs Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto agregando PAX una sola vez por numero_ticket. Solo lectura.

queries.name: estelar_sep_runtime_vs_detalle
queries.sql: WITH rt AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS ventas_runtime, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) AS tickets_runtime, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_runtime FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-09-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-15' AND (ISNULL(ventas_total,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(tickets_total,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(pax_total,0)<>0) GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)), dt_ticket AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha, numero_ticket, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS venta_ticket, MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-09-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-15' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date), numero_ticket), dt AS (SELECT fecha, SUM(venta_ticket) AS ventas_detalle, COUNT(*) AS tickets_detalle, SUM(pax_ticket) AS pax_detalle FROM dt_ticket GROUP BY fecha) SELECT rt.fecha, rt.ventas_runtime, ISNULL(dt.ventas_detalle,0) AS ventas_detalle, CAST(rt.ventas_runtime-ISNULL(dt.ventas_detalle,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta_ventas, rt.tickets_runtime, ISNULL(dt.tickets_detalle,0) AS tickets_detalle, rt.tickets_runtime-ISNULL(dt.tickets_detalle,0) AS delta_tickets, rt.pax_runtime, ISNULL(dt.pax_detalle,0) AS pax_detalle, rt.pax_runtime-ISNULL(dt.pax_detalle,0) AS delta_pax, CASE WHEN dt.fecha IS NULL THEN 'DETALLE_AUSENTE' WHEN ABS(rt.ventas_runtime-ISNULL(dt.ventas_detalle,0))>0.05 OR rt.tickets_runtime<>ISNULL(dt.tickets_detalle,0) OR rt.pax_runtime<>ISNULL(dt.pax_detalle,0) THEN 'NO_CONCILIA' ELSE 'OK' END AS estado FROM rt LEFT JOIN dt ON dt.fecha=rt.fecha ORDER BY rt.fecha
